Captured live, never authored: two palette write logs of the packed protocols, each armed right
after `start` and read after `run_for(frames=600)`, and the palette device read by `palette` at
the same stop, the ground truth the decoding is judged by.

speedf-*   Speed Fight (`mamespeedf` from speedf-mame, set `speedf`, V30), the `latch` entry
           of speedf-palette.yaml, data port 0x8 and index port 0xa in the io space.
           speedf-dump.txt.gz   the dump the log's dumper wrote at that stop
           speedf-palette.json  `palette`'s `colors` for pens 0..1023, four pages joined
lineup-*   Line UP (`mamelineup` from lineup-mame, set `lineup`, V30), the `sequence` entry
           of lineup-palette.yaml, data port 0x6 and reset port 0xe in the io space, armed
           where `start` parked, so the offset the driver zeroes as its video starts is known.
           lineup-dump.txt.gz   the dump, as above
           lineup-palette.json  `palette`'s `colors` for pens 0..255
*-palette.yaml   the entries the logs were armed from, read from each driver's source.

A change in what the dumper writes is RE-CAPTURED here, never patched in the fixture.
